## Quarto

```{r}
if(!require(devtools)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("kassambara/ggpubr")

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library("ggpubr")

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)

# Loading data
df_energy_index <- read.csv("EnergyIndexUrbanHouseholdCost.csv")
df_cpi_energy <- read.csv("ConsumerPriceEnergyUSA.csv")
df_natgas_consumption <- read.csv("ResidentialEnergyInflationTrend.csv")
df_res_energy_inflation <- read.csv("ResidentialEnergyInflationTrend.csv")

# Merging datasets
merged_data <- merge(df_energy_index, df_cpi_energy, by = "DATE", all = TRUE)
merged_data <- merge(merged_data, df_natgas_consumption, by = "DATE", all = TRUE)
merged_data <- merge(merged_data, df_res_energy_inflation, by = "DATE", all = TRUE)

# Converting DATE column to Date type
merged_data$DATE <- as.Date(paste0(merged_data$DATE, "-01-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Drop rows with NA in DATE (recommended for clean plotting)
merged_data <- merged_data %>% drop_na(DATE)

# Renaming columns for readability
colnames(merged_data) <- c("DATE", "Energy_Index", "CPI_Energy", "NatGas_Consumption", "Res_Energy_Inflation")

# Creating individual line plots
plot_energy_index <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = DATE, y = Energy_Index)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Energy Index", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_cpi_energy <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = DATE, y = CPI_Energy)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "CPI Energy", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_natgas_consumption <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = DATE, y = NatGas_Consumption)) +
  geom_line(color = "green") +
  labs(title = "Natural Gas Consumption", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_res_energy_inflation <- ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = DATE, y = Res_Energy_Inflation)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Residential Energy Inflation", x = "Date", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# Arranging all plots together with a common legend
ggarrange(plot_energy_index, plot_cpi_energy, plot_natgas_consumption, plot_res_energy_inflation,
          ncol = 1, nrow = 4, common.legend = FALSE)

```
